exposure: "3H" reinforced adhesive tape for endotracheal tube fixation
traditional "H" type adhesive tape for endotracheal tube fixation
cohort: A total of 120 critically ill neonates admitted to the Neonatology Department of a hospital from February 2020 to February 2021.
finding: The "3H" reinforced adhesive tape fixation method for endotracheal tubes in critically ill neonates resulted in less tracheal intubation displacement, improved comfort, lower incidence of facial skin injury, mouth corner injury, emphysema, tracheal injury, reduced child mortality, and shorter hospitalization time and expenses compared to the traditional "H" type adhesive tape.
